summary: Retested the v72h/v72i consortium payment-instruction fixes. (1) Race fixed: test_v72h_split_race.py passed 9 of 9 runs. The new same-line race test (both officers sign the same line at once, 6 parallel requests, 4 runs) always kept both signatures and ended APPROVED. One-side-only signing never approves. (2) Paid: a proof_key that is not in db.uploads gets 422 'Attach the bank payment slip first'. A bank account changed after signing gets 409. With 4 concurrent paid calls, exactly one gets 200 and three get 409. (3) Magic link: GET /magic/{token}/consortium-splits lists only splits on the token's account (another account's tx is excluded) and has no _id. POST .../sign signs as escrow_institution with via=magic_link and the comment, then approves after the PMC sign. Re-sign gets 409, a tx on another account gets 403, bad or revoked tokens get 404, a bad idx or tid gets 404. UI at /escrow/officer/:token shows magic-split-section, magic-split-<tid> and split-sign-<tid>-<i>, with no split-paid button (also none after APPROVED). Cancel on the prompt sent no request; OK signed it, showed a toast and the status changed to APPROVED. (4) Admin ConsortiumSplitBox: Cancel aborts (no request), the paid line shows split-slip and Open slip returns 200 and opens a new tab. One new bug: Open slip on the magic-link portal returns 401.

minor.issue: proof_key is only checked for existence in db.uploads, with no check on scope or owner. /api/v1/uploads/direct accepts uploads without auth, and any existing key passes (for example another vendor's doc or a bid-docs key). Consider requiring scope 'vendor-docs/' or a dedicated 'escrow-slips/' scope and recording the uploader.
Requires a signed-in user, so magic-link officers cannot view slips (see the frontend issue).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Open slip' button (split-slip-<tid>-<i>) is shown to the external magic-link officer. Clicking it calls /api/v1/uploads/files/<key>, which returns 401, and the toast says 'Something went wrong · HTTP 401'. Either add a token-scoped endpoint (for example GET /api/v1/escrow/magic/{token}/consortium-split/{tid}/{idx}/slip, checking that the tx is on the token's account) or hide the button on the magic portal (for example act.canViewSlip=false).

issues: For a released tx the top block shows 'No pending transactions on this account.' right above pending payment instructions. The wording is slightly confusing; consider 'No pending EMD releases'.

action_items: Fix 'Open slip' on the magic-link officer portal (401). Add a token-scoped slip endpoint or hide the button there.
Optional: tighten the proof_key check (scope prefix / uploader) for paid.
critical_code_review_comments: _sign and mark_paid now use positional $set with status filters, and approval is a separate conditional update that requires both signature keys. This is correct, and an approval can no longer be lost because whichever sign finishes second performs it.
_magic only checks revoked. Magic tokens never expire (this was already the case for /magic/{token}). Consider adding expires_at.
The magic-split list returns every member's bank details to the token holder. This is intended for the officer, but the token is a bearer secret with no expiry.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_v72h_consortium_split_signing.py (paid now uses a real db.uploads key PROOF because fake keys get 422; the vendor is upserted with a unique vendor_ref so the vendor_ref_1 unique index does not collide with null under xdist)
/app/backend/tests/test_v72i_split_magic_paid.py (new: same-line race, paid guards, concurrent paid, magic-link list/sign/403/404)
